payout_quote: With Contra's commission-free payment platform, creatives keep 100% of what they earn
steps: Create a free Contra profile and build your portfolio (AI-assisted portfolio tools available).
Post your work to the Contra feed to get discovered by clients.
Browse and apply to project opportunities, or get hired directly by companies discovering your profile.
Agree on scope and price; use Contra's built-in contracts, invoicing, and messaging.
Get paid through Contra with 0% platform commission (standard Stripe processing fees still apply).
catches: 0% commission, but Stripe payment-processing fees still apply to payouts.
Discovery-based: with 1M+ independents on the platform, getting noticed takes consistent posting and a strong portfolio — no guaranteed clients.
You do your own pitching and negotiating; Contra does not hand you work.
Optional paid extras (Contra Pro, custom domains) cost money — not required to earn.
Income depends entirely on winning clients; nothing is promised.
biggest_catch: There is no guaranteed work: Contra is a discovery network, so earnings depend entirely on your ability to attract and close clients yourself.
eligibility: Free account; independent creatives and freelancers (designers, developers, writers, marketers, etc.).
timing: Work when you want; payouts via Contra's payment platform after client approval.

c1.evidence: Contra's own site (contra.com) states the mechanism: 'No middlemen. No commission fees. Just direct collaboration between the world's most creative people and the companies who want to work with them' and 'creatives keep 100% of what they earn'.

c2.evidence: Official terms publish no fixed pay amounts — pricing is per project between freelancer and client; framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: profile/portfolio, feed posting, discovery or application, contracts, commission-free payouts.

c4.evidence: Core platform is free with 0% commission; no upfront fee to earn documented.
